As a Lead Process Engineer Logistics Inbound and Outbound (m/f/d) with a focus on pharmaceutical and biotechnological process design, you will drive high-quality technical solutions and lead complex projects from early concept through final design or redesign.

You will work with a highly skilled team at our regional office in Bad Homburg or Stuttgart, Germany, where collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous learning are central to the way we work. You will be part of an international, professional and committed environment that supports ongoing improvement and development.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

Lead logistics process planning for inbound, automated warehousing, robotics, outbound, and intra-production logistics in biotechnological manufacturing environments.
Manage all project phases and budgets, from feasibility and concept design through detailed design, construction, commissioning, and qualification.
Assess customer requirements, develop concepts, provide process-level consulting, and present solutions to internal and external stakeholders.
Create layouts and process flow diagrams, prepare technical and commercial documentation (URS, TS), and support equipment and IT software selection.
Drive key technical decisions, design reviews, workshops, and risk analyses (HAZID, HAZOP) to ensure project performance, quality, compliance, and stakeholder alignment.

- Deep understanding of logistics processes, strong IT affinity, and experience with transport and warehouse management systems such as SAP IM/WM or Insite LMS.
